GOOD TO KNOW

A few useful answers.

Can flags be used outdoors?

The selected pole, base, flag and placement must be suitable for outdoor use. Tell us about the surface and exposure so the setup can be reviewed.

Is delivery and installation included?

Ask for the services you need. Delivery, installation and collection are separately confirmed in the rental scope based on location and access.

How much notice do I need?

Share your dates as early as possible. Availability, preparation and transport requirements determine whether a rental can be arranged.
